creation_method: Questions authored directly from the verified frozen chunk catalogue by the assistant. No OpenAPI schema, LLM client, or production retriever was invoked to create this candidate file.

question_type_definitions.single_chunk: One chunk should fully support the answer.
question_type_definitions.multiple_chunks_same_document: Multiple chunks from one document are required.
question_type_definitions.dual_document: Evidence from at least two different documents is required.

evaluation_contract.scored_stage: Only the final global-fusion output after reranking and adaptive-K selection from the production retrieval orchestrator.
evaluation_contract.result_capture: Store the actual ranked final result list and actual returned count (up to the adaptive maximum). Do not pad results when adaptive-K returns fewer than K.
evaluation_contract.ground_truth_rule: Proposed evidence anchors are generation provenance only, not relevance labels. Human review must inspect the entire frozen 485-chunk corpus and add all relevant chunks, including relevant chunks not returned by the retriever.
evaluation_contract.lifecycle: Candidates -> human question validation -> production retrieval snapshot -> corpus-wide relevance judgments -> frozen benchmark -> repeated retrieval runs and metric comparison.
